name: Up to Snuff
statusNote: Unchanged in Forever as far as is known: the text, objectives and rewards below are Classic’s.
footerSourceNote: Text, givers, objectives and rewards come from the cMaNGOS Classic database (a reconstruction of the 1.12 world), with what Forever changed on top: the game server’s own answers where we have them, else Wowhead’s Forever database. narrative.details:
Ah, the sea life.  I ain't gonna say it's the good life, but it's my life.

When I get into port I like to find me a good bottle of grog and some high quality snuff.  Nasty habits but what's a pirate without his vices, right?

So you can imagine how heartbroken I was to find out the herbalist here in town has gone and sold out of the stuff.  Says his shipment got hijacked by those damned Bloodsail Raiders.

I bet a fearless champion like you could convince 'em to share the goods, eh?
narrative.objectives: Deeg in Booty Bay wants you to bring him 15 shares of Snuff.
narrative.offerRewardText: Good show, adventurer! And just before I need to ship out too! Can't thank you enough, old friend.
narrative.requestItemsText: Any luck finding the goods, matey?
